old_pool: adopt original eligible pool minus known owner errors; no temporal screen; union individually human-confirmed positives by original item_id
new_pool: keep only dual-model citation-validated non-temporary items; adopt only after independent owner blind audit
stop: target joint pool sufficient for reliable union target after audit allowance, or exhaust unused reserve
new_key_preflight: temperature zero, disabled thinking, five consistent decisions, 100 distinct format samples at least 99 valid, actual successful call
redo: entire unfinished batch index4, both sides; all old side results retired and never replayed
later_quota_switch: qualified same-role independent-vendor replacement; whole affected side of current batch, never partial splice
judge: per table exclude answer and actual adopted annotation vendors; main plus at least one qualified backup; human calibration required before formal scores
